lines.spoken: To verify the chain, a client needs every certificate from the root down to the C.A. that issued the client's certificate.

lines.text: Cross-certifying CAs: horizontal trust between two CAs.
lines.spoken: Cross-certifying C.A.s: horizontal trust between two C.A.s.

lines.text: Subordinate CA servers can be invalidated.
lines.spoken: Subordinate C.A. servers can be invalidated.
